title: With name_requires_address off, any mention of the name gets an answer

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: olisar was down for like an hour yesterday

notes: Proves the setting is wired to something rather than merely stored. The identical line to beat 1 of addressing-passing-mention, with the knob inverted and the opposite assertion — so the pair fails loudly if the config stops reaching the listener. Not a quality case: the old always-answer behaviour is what an operator opts back into, and this only checks they still can.
